input.name: tiles
input.layout: NCHW-flat: each row is one 32x32 grayscale tile, row-major, reshaped to [n,1,32,32] inside the model
input.note: Board crop resized to 256x256 (bilinear) after luma conversion 0.299R+0.587G+0.114B; split into 8x8 tiles of 32x32, image-oriented, row-major from top-left

class_note: index 0 = empty ('1'); 1-6 = white K Q R B N P (uppercase); 7-12 = black k q r b n p (lowercase)
licence_note: Weights trained by us on lichess piece sets (see docs/MODEL_CARD.md); architecture adapted from fenshot (MIT)
int8: not shipped: dynamic-quantised file uses ConvInteger, which onnxruntime CPU cannot run
